database.instructions: This platform enables AI-powered 3D world creation. Users can upload assets (3D models, textures, audio) and use natural language to build and modify immersive environments. The scene_data field contains the complete 3D scene configuration including object positions, lighting, animations, and spatial relationships. AI interactions modify this data in real-time while maintaining spatial consistency and scene memory. World events can be triggered by prompts to create dynamic, living environments that respond to user commands.
